submission.signature: v: decimal string 27 or 28; r,s: lowercase bytes32
submission.receipt: intentId, action, state, queueRevision (decimal string); acceptance is not execution confirmation
submission.retry: No automatic retries after uncertain responses

evidence.nonce: Frontend generates a random 24-bit word times 256, then persists and increments under browser lock, scoped to chain/verifying contract/session-or-paper/user. The helper requires caller-provided decimal nonce and does not reserve it.
evidence.status: Queue rank only. Pending operations and outcome patches are in /state/user/live?wallet={wallet}, not a verified standalone GET /intents/{id} endpoint.
evidence.intentId: keccak256(concat(keccak256(utf8("papertrade:intent-id:v2")), EIP712 digest, recovered signer address)); helper requires expectedIntentId from caller.
evidence.openSizeUnits: 18-decimal margin, not instrument quantity; leverage is an unscaled uint32.
notVerified: Authorization requirements beyond browser credentials and signed payload
Contract ABI and signer recovery in this helper
